text: ik zou niet weten of het een goede app is. Ik krijg sowieso de Franstalige versie terwijl ik Nederlandstalig ben. Dit kan ook niet aangepast worden.
author: Kirsten Mannaerts
developer_reply:
Unfortunately, we don’t currently offer a Dutch version of the app, but English, Spanish, German, and Polish are available in the Settings section.

If you have trouble changing the language, please contact hello@inflow.io and we’ll help you out.

text: Ik had no time during the trial periode. Therefore I wanted to stop. They make it impossible to unsubscribe.
author: Age Terpstra
developer_reply:
We’re sorry to hear that you had this experience. We understand that life can get busy, and we never want cancelling to feel frustrating or difficult.

If you ever need help with your subscription or cancellation, please feel free to reach out to us directly at hello@getinflow.io and our team will be happy to assist you.

text: do not install or fill in the questionnaires/forms. they will make it hard for you to find a way to unsubscribe. predatory behavior.
author: Tijmen J.
developer_reply:
Thanks for sharing your feedback—we’re sorry this was your experience.
Unsubscribing should always be simple, and we don’t aim to make that process difficult. If you need any help, please reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io and we’ll sort it out quickly.

text: geen idee over de echte functionaliteiten van het product. ik vind het jammer dat je eerst een hele vragenlijst invult en een account aanmaakt om erachter te komen dat er geen gratis versie is om dit te volgen.. er is wel een 7 daagse try out, mocht je dit willen gebruikem. Maar ik denk zelf eigenlijk dat dit een beetje inspeelt op de zwakke punten van de adhd-er en veel mensen dan onbewust toch gaan betalen ervoor. bah...
author: Remco Raven
developer_reply: We want to help everyone with ADHD, regardless of finances. Our Inflow Access Program offers free access to Inflow, and our refund policy was designed up accomodate people who forget to cancel their trial. We know how hard it can be with ADHD and the last thing we want to do is make life harder! Find out more at https://www.getinflow.io/faqs

text: Why is it not clear beforehand that a subscription is required. Am i missing something? It lets you invest "time" at first to answer questions and account creation, and then...they mention the trial and cost. The app might be great, but this feels as a red flag to me.
author: Guido Santen
developer_reply: Hello! We know the full cost of Inflow might not be accessible to everyone. We're committed to helping everyone with ADHD reach their full potential, regardless of finances. That's why we created the Inflow Access Program, which offers free access to Inflow for one year. You can find out more here: https://www.getinflow.io/faqs

author: Cathelijne Spoelstra

text: They make you do the entire application process and then whej they hint they are going to give you some tips they cheerily ask you for $220+ dollars after 5 days. Waste of time.
author: A W
developer_reply: We're sorry to hear you had a negative experience. We do offer a 7-day free trial, but we're sorry you weren't aware of this when signing up. Our pricing ($199.99 for a year) reflects the costs of employing clinicians, coaches, and engineers to create and maintain the app. If you have any questions, please reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io.

author: Gijsbo2000

author: Babet
developer_reply: Hi Babet, a lot of work goes into an app like Inflow and we charge for it to compensate our amazing team of engineers, designers, clinicians etc. who work very hard to make it as great as possible for our members.

text: This app is way too expensive for an app. There are many similar apps, I'm not gonna pay €23 every month/€100 euros for a year to use this one.

developer_reply: Hi there, We charge for this app to compensate the incredible team of writers, engineers, clinicians, and more who work super hard to continue improving Inflow.
